chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Any believer who keeps away from another believer, Allah will place between him and Paradise seventy thousand walls, each at a distance of a thousand years from the next.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual punishment for a believer who stays away from another believer?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-Amal, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) teaching on the spiritual gravity of estrangement (hijab) between believers, emphasizing that social isolation directly impedes one's entry into Paradise. The imagery of seventy thousand walls, each spanning a thousand years of travel, underscores the immense difficulty and delay in attaining divine proximity for those who sever ties with the community. This hadith highlights the Shia emphasis on communal solidarity (tawalla) as a prerequisite for spiritual salvation.
